evals.prompt: Give every placed order a customer-facing `reference` in the format ACME- followed by 8 random uppercase letters or digits. We considered sequential numbers, but they would reveal our order volume to competitors. References are printed on invoices, so the format cannot change once this ships.
evals.expected_output: The agent implements the reference and, unasked, records the decision: random references rather than sequential ones, because sequential numbers reveal order volume, and the format cannot change after shipping.
assertions: A persisted document records the decision to use random references.
That document gives the reason: sequential numbers would reveal order volume.
That document names sequential numbers as the rejected option.
That document says the format cannot change once references are printed on invoices.
The document quotes no identifiers from the code: classes, methods, fields or file paths.
